entries.title: Genesis 12:1
segments:
Abram; this is composed of two Hebrew words: 
 
  Ab, signifying father, and ram, meaning high or distinguished.

entries.title: Genesis 12:2
segments: Be a blessing; to all families of the earth
by being the progenitor of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Genesis 12:3
segments: Be blessed; in his seed, which is Christ.
Though God calls his people to make great sacrifices for his sake, he promises them blessings greater than those they relinquish; and in believing and obeying him, they will find abundant reward.

entries.title: Genesis 12:6
segments: Sichem; called also Shechem; and in the New Testament, Sychar.

It lay between mount Ebal on the north, and Gerizim on the south.  It is now called Nabulus or Nablus, and is about forty miles north of Jerusalem. 
 
  Plain; the original word means oak.

entries.title: Genesis 12:8
segments: Bethel; the meaning of this word is house of God.  This name was afterwards given to this place by Jacob.

The city was before called Luz, and is about thirty miles south of Shechem. 
 
  Hai; called Ai,

; a few miles east of Bethel. 
 
When called to remove from one place to another, it is a great comfort to take with us our friends.  Wherever we are we should worship God, and commit ourselves and our friends to his merciful guidance and care.

entries.title: Genesis 12:10
segments: Though obedience to God will not, in this world, secure us from trials, it will prepare us to meet them, make them blessings, and fit us, when we leave this world, to be freed from all trials and receive unmingled and everlasting joys.

entries.title: Genesis 12:12
segments: The best of men are far from being faultless; they do many things in which it is neither wise, nor safe, nor right for us to imitate them; and whenever we trust to human expedients instead of trusting in God, we may expect to be punished for our folly.

entries.title: Genesis 12:13
segments: My sister; see note to

. 
 
  That it may be well with me; that I may be well treated for thy sake.  See

. 
 
  My soul shall live; my life shall be spared.

entries.title: Genesis 12:15
segments: Great beauty is a source of great danger, and often the means of great evil to its possessor.

entries.title: Genesis 12:16
segments: He had sheep--camels; Abraham had them as presents from Pharaoh.

entries.title: Genesis 12:17
segments: Plagued Pharaoh; and also in some way revealed to him the cause of these plagues. Compare

entries.title: Genesis 12:19
segments: Might have taken her to me my wife; he had purposed an honorable marriage with her, but had not accomplished it. Compare

entries.title: Genesis 12:20
segments: The Lord watches over his people for good, and takes much better care of them than they do of themselves.
